script:
set -e
TOK=$(cat ~/.cache/huggingface/token)
curl -sfL -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -o /tmp/ckpt_n.pt https://huggingface.co/datasets/miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets/resolve/main/checkpoints/kazbek-run-n-mip/ckpt_99999_rank0.pt
cd /workspace/gsplat && python3 examples/simple_trainer.py default \
  --data-dir /workspace/scenes/kazbek-run-c10 --data-factor 1 \
  --result-dir /workspace/results/eval-n-views \
  --ckpt /tmp/ckpt_n.pt --antialiased --disable-viewer
STAGE=/workspace/results/eval-n-views
ls $STAGE/renders | head
PICK=$(ls $STAGE/renders/*.png | head -8)
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/hf_upload.py --repo miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets --prefix eval/kazbek-run-n-trainer-views $PICK $STAGE/stats/*.json
echo EVAL-N-VIEWS-DONE
